prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical editorial poster combining a warm cinematic lifestyle photograph with a torn-paper collage aesthetic, centered on a young woman with short wet black hair reading a red book while lying on a brown sofa.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, about 900 x 1200 px. Split the composition horizontally into 2 distinct sections: the top half is a full-bleed realistic photograph, and the bottom half is a cream handmade-paper design with a large torn opening revealing the same photograph underneath.

Top section: Show the subject reclining diagonally on a textured brown couch near a window, wearing a loose sleeveless sky-blue dress with thin side ties. She is lying on red patterned cushions with small floral fabric patches, holding a glossy red book close to her face so it partly hides her mouth and nose. Her expression is quiet and absorbed, eyes visible over the book. Use soft afternoon window light from the upper right, warm shadows, natural film photography grain, intimate indoor atmosphere, slightly high camera angle.

Bottom section: Create an aged off-white paper background with subtle fiber texture, stains, deckled edges, and handmade stationery feeling. In the center, make 1 large irregular vertical ripped crack/opening with rough layered paper edges, exposing a cropped duplicate of the woman reading beneath it. Add 4 torn colored-paper fragments around the opening: one red fragment near the top, one muted blue fragment at the upper right, one beige fragment along the lower left edge, and one dark fragment near the lower center. The exposed image should look slightly flatter and more printed, like a magazine photo embedded under torn paper.

Text content: Add Japanese editorial typography in thin, elegant Mincho-style characters. On the left side of the bottom paper, large vertical/stacked text reads ページの\n向こうに、\nどこかのわたし。. Below it, smaller text reads 読んでいるのは、\n物語か、\nそれとも、\n少しだけ未来。. On the right side, add a small vertical Japanese note reading こんな午後が、\nずっと続けばいい。. Keep the text sparse and airy, with generous margins.

Decorative details: Include exactly 2 pressed dried flower sprigs: one small reddish flower cluster near the lower center-left of the torn opening, and one longer thin-stem flower sprig near the lower right. Add 3 faint pencil-like curved scribble lines across the paper: one large loose curve on the right, one short underline-like stroke below the left text, and one long sweeping line from the lower left toward the center. No logos, no watermarks, no extra text.

Visual style: Japanese magazine cover, poetic paper collage, tactile torn paper, wabi-sabi stationery design, warm nostalgic color grading, realistic photography mixed with handcrafted paper texture, calm literary mood.

promptZh:
目标：创作一张竖版编辑海报，将温暖的电影感生活照与撕纸拼贴美学相结合，主体为 一位留着湿润黑色短发的年轻女性，正躺在棕色沙发上阅读一本红色书籍。

画布：竖版 3:4 海报，约 900 x 1200 像素。将构图水平分为两个截然不同的部分：上半部分为全出血的写实摄影，下半部分为奶油色手工纸设计，中间有一个巨大的撕裂开口，露出底下的同一张照片。

上半部分：展示主体斜倚在窗边质感十足的棕色沙发上，身穿 一件带有细侧系带的宽松天蓝色无袖连衣裙。她躺在带有小碎花布料补丁的红色图案靠垫上，手中拿着一本亮面红书，书本遮住了她部分口鼻。她神情安静而专注，双眼在书本上方显露。使用来自右上角的柔和午后窗光，营造温暖的阴影、自然的胶片摄影颗粒感、私密的室内氛围，以及略微俯视的拍摄角度。

下半部分：创建一个带有细微纤维纹理、污渍、毛边和手工文具质感的陈旧米白色纸张背景。在中心位置制作 1 个巨大的不规则垂直撕裂裂缝/开口，边缘呈现粗糙的纸张分层感，露出下方裁剪后的女性阅读照片。在开口周围添加 4 个撕碎的彩色纸片：顶部附近一个红色碎片，右上角一个柔和的蓝色碎片，左下边缘一个米色碎片，底部中心附近一个深色碎片。露出的图像应看起来稍微扁平且具有印刷感，就像嵌入在撕纸下的杂志照片一样。

文字内容：添加纤细、优雅的明朝体日式编辑排版。在底部纸张的左侧，大型垂直/堆叠文字为 ページの\n向こうに、\nどこかのわたし。。下方较小的文字为 読んでいるのは、\n物語か、\nそれとも、\n少しだけ未来。。在右侧，添加一行小的垂直日文注释 こんな午後が、\nずっと続けばいい。。保持文字稀疏且留白充裕，留出宽敞的页边距。

装饰细节：包含 2 枝压制干花：撕裂开口左下方一簇红色小花，右下方一枝较长的细茎花。在纸面上添加 3 条淡淡的铅笔风格曲线涂鸦：右侧一条大的松散曲线，左侧文字下方一条短的下划线式笔触，以及从左下角向中心延伸的一条长长的扫线。无标志，无水印，无额外文字。

视觉风格：日式杂志封面、诗意纸张拼贴、触感撕纸、侘寂文具设计、温暖怀旧调色、写实摄影与手工纸质感的融合、宁静的文学氛围。
